one_line: L135 DISCHARGED ON THE BUILD SIDE: the frame, the floor and M12 are rebuilt on this bench from B854 + B961/frame.py and pass a 51/51 validation gate against banked numbers at two primes never used here (41131, 41201) -- floor 12, M12 12, M12^core 0, plus frame Gram diagonal signature (2,2) with the four ledger norms digit-identical, core 30, derived(floor) 8 with centre 0, nu=c*kappa^6 deg 18, kappa coefficient-identical with const -19^3 and disc kernel {7,11}, wall dims [30,30,30] with pairwise AND triple intersections all equal to the floor closing 3*30-3*12+12=66, M12 torus-invariant with charge ranks [12,12,12,12], and the mu-walls DERIVED from M12 itself (det12 = c*cubic^4, deg<=12 structural) so no external cubic is fed in and the two-normalization hazard cannot bite. On top of the validated frame the WEIGHT-LINE DECOMPOSITION OF M12 -- named by the scout as reconstructible but not run -- now runs: 12 one-dimensional common eigenlines with 12 DISTINCT weight 4-tuples, 6 distinct eigenvalues per charge (3 +- pairs), closed under EXACTLY the B939 W_frame Klein group (and NOT under any of four non-W_frame sign patterns), three FREE orbits of size 4, su(3)_colour := derived(floor) acting as rank 0. With presence7.py all SEVEN B958 presence-side legs are now computable here (previously zero): [M12,M12] dim 16 escaping by exactly 4 AND the escape LOCALIZED into the torus (sharper than the claim), [floor,M12] rank 12 escape 0, [so(10),M12] escape 50, centre 0 exact over Q. TWO REDUCTIONS: (a) the orbit<->generation bijection is FORCED by the weight-line and W_frame legs plus ratio-distinctness -- it is a corollary, not an eighth independent fact, and should not be counted as one; (b) 'M12 ^ core = 0' is a WEAK check since 12+30<78 makes it generic -- non-vacuous (controls return 12 and 4) but the real content sits in span=66 and the triple-intersection-equals-floor numbers. ONE NEW STRUCTURAL FACT, arithmetic and born from a recorded FAILURE rather than tuned away: the first run crashed at p=41201 because ad(g14)|M12 had eigenvalues outside F_p; instead of fishing for a passing prime the splitting condition was stated as an explicit prime criterion in advance, the window scanned and reported (4/10 admissible), then measured per-charge over 24 kappa-split primes -- the NONCOMPACT weights g8,g16 lie in F_p at 24/24 while the COMPACT weights g14,g22 do so at only 16/24 and fail TOTALLY when they fail (residual 12, no eigenvalue in F_p, i.e. 6 irreducible quadratics). Since mu splits at every kappa-split prime (CHECKED here at all 24, not inherited from the one-field theorem), 'in F_p' means 'in the wall field K', NOT 'rational': so the noncompact weights live in K itself while the compact weights need a PROPER EXTENSION of K -- the frame's compact/noncompact split is mirrored in the arithmetic of the M12 weights. SCOPED HONESTLY: 16/24 is consistent with density 1/2 (two-sided p~0.15) and 24 primes CANNOT identify the extension; the natural guess Q(sqrt77) was NOT tested because every prime in the scan splits kappa and therefore already forces 77 to be a QR -- the check would be VACUOUS (MB12), so the field is left as a stated open question rather than guessed. WHAT REMAINS BLOCKED IS UNCHANGED AND IS A TIER GAP, NOT A DEFINITIONAL ONE: char-0 exactification over K (this cell added primes, not tier -- four independent primes is not a certificate), the identity of the compact weight extension, conjugacy of derived(floor) with the standard A2 Levi (equal centralizer dimension 16 is consistent with but not proof of conjugacy), import I-4 (G2+G2 not in e6), and the presence side's own section text which remains incoming. REPRESENTATION NAMED THROUGHOUT: g8,g14,g16,g22 are ADJOINT-sector elements of e6; every construction is a centralizer or Killing complement and is therefore RANK-PRESERVING; NO 27 VEV appears anywhere in this cell, so nothing here reaches rank 4 and nothing here claims to. Corrections owed and restated: B958 FINDINGS:11,19 'no independent construction of M12' is incorrect as stated (B911_cmt_document had it -- B958's method was right, its premise wrong); B961 FINDINGS:60-62 likewise; CMT_DRAFT.md:190's W_frame VERIFICATION PENDING row is stale. Nothing banked; this is a rebuild plus evidence, NOT a verification of the presence side, and it makes no Standard Model claim.
